passage:
14 March, night. Disha's diary.

Today a girl named Mehak messaged me. Very polite. She asked if I knew Arjun, because she'd found my photos on his phone. She has been with him for two years.

I read it four times. My hands went cold, then hot. Two years. He told me his last relationship ended before we met.

I typed a message to Mehak asking who she thought she was, then deleted it. She didn't know either. She's been lied to as long as I have.

So I called Arjun. I said, "I know everything. Don't contact me again." My voice shook but I said it. Then I blocked him.

I'm so angry I can't sit still. But I also miss him, which makes me angrier. Tomorrow I'll tell Mehak thank you, and that's all.

qa.q: How long has Mehak been with Arjun?
qa.a: Mehak has been with Arjun for two years.

qa.q: What made Disha delete the message Disha typed to Mehak?
qa.a: Disha realised Mehak had not known either and had been lied to just as long, so Arjun was the one to face, not Mehak.

qa.q: What did Disha do that was wise, and what might help Disha afterwards?
qa.a: Disha confronted Arjun and cut contact, then decided to thank Mehak only; talking with trusted friends could help with the anger and the missing him.

qa.q: How might Mehak have felt sending that message to Disha?
qa.a: Mehak was probably shaken and hurt too, and sent it politely because she was trying to find out the truth.

grounding: Shows learning a loved one hid a partner, feeling anger, ending contact, and seeing the other partner was deceived too.

passage: Counselling note, Tuesday. Ojas (second year, physics) came in angry and shaking. Three days ago he discovered that Bhavna, whom he has dated for five months, has had a long-term boyfriend in her hometown the whole time. He found out when the boyfriend visited campus. Ojas said his first impulse was to confront the boyfriend and 'show him the messages', and admitted he had drafted a long message to him. He also said he felt stupid and guilty, as if he had done something wrong. We talked about how he, too, was deceived: Bhavna lied to both of them, and the boyfriend is not his enemy. Ojas decided not to send the draft. He has blocked Bhavna's number and asked a friend to collect his things from her place. He is angry, and that is fair. We have agreed to meet weekly for now.

qa.q: How did Ojas find out about the hometown boyfriend?
What was Ojas feeling when he came in?
qa.a: He was angry and shaking, and also felt stupid and guilty.

qa.q: What did Ojas decide to do?
qa.a: Not to send the message to the boyfriend, to block Bhavna, have a friend collect his things, and keep seeing the counsellor.

qa.q: How is the hometown boyfriend affected by Bhavna's lies?
qa.a: He was deceived too, so he isn't Ojas's enemy but another person Bhavna lied to.

grounding: A counsellor's note on a young man who learns his girlfriend hid a partner, feeling anger, ending contact and seeing he too was deceived.

passage:
Wednesday night. I still can't believe I'm writing this. Baljeet is engaged. Engaged! His fiancée, Simran, messaged me today: 'Are you seeing my fiancé?' She'd found my photos on his phone. For eight months he told me he was single, that his family 'had no plans' for him. My hands shook so badly I dropped my chai. First I was furious at Simran, for some reason, as if she'd stolen something. I typed a nasty reply. Then I stopped. She didn't lie to me. He did. She's been lied to as well, probably for longer than me. So I wrote back: 'I didn't know. I'm so sorry. He told me he was single.' Then I blocked Baljeet everywhere. I called Didi and cried for an hour. I'm so angry I can barely breathe, and I have every right to be. But I'm not going to fight the wrong person.
- Pallavi

qa.q: How did Simran find out about Pallavi?
qa.a: She found Pallavi's photos on Baljeet's phone.

qa.q: What was Pallavi feeling after Simran's message?
qa.a: Pallavi felt shocked and furious, hands shaking so badly the chai fell.

qa.q: What did Pallavi do instead of attacking Simran?
qa.a: Replied honestly with an apology, explaining Baljeet had claimed to be single, then blocked Baljeet and called Didi for support.

qa.q: How has Simran been affected by Baljeet's lies?
qa.a: She has been lied to as well, probably for even longer.

grounding: A diary of a young person who discovers their partner was engaged all along, feeling the anger, ending contact and refusing to fight the other deceived partner.
